differences_from_pinned_upstream: FIRST/BULK only at idle; MIDDLE/LAST only while collecting
Match channel and encryption/control metadata on every fragment
Require exact LAST plaintext total, prohibit extra total field on non-FIRST
Caller-owned bounded storage and finite fragment count; no automatic resynchronization
Callback-only complete-message publication with explicit fragment accepted status
Empty/1-byte assembled messages allowed; downstream dispatcher validates message ID
